item.title: King to address slavery in Commonwealth speech in Antigua
item.body: King Charles III will deliver a speech to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday as he concludes his nine-day Caribbean tour. He is expected to address slavery during the final leg of the visit.

photo.credit: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 👑 King to address slavery in Commonwealth speech in Antigua

King Charles III will deliver a speech to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday as he concludes his nine-day Caribbean tour. He is expected to address slavery during the final leg of the visit.

Source: BBC | Image: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons
UK Daily Briefing | 1 November, 14:50
